THOMSON BROTHERS
INDUSTRIES
Location: 210 Holt Road
Phone: 978-686-2020
Hours of Operation:
Monday – Friday 5:00am – 4:00pm
Saturday 7:00am -11:00am
TBI generously allows the residents of North Andover
to dispose of trash for a fee and normal household
recycling free of charge.

Normal household recycling would be items
commonly placed in your curbside recycling toter.
Plastic Bags, Bubble Wrap, Plastic Wrap, Tanglers, or
Hazardous Items are NEVER allowed in the recycling
toter, recycling dumpster or recycling containers.

PLEASE KEEP THESE ITEMS OUT OF THE
RECYCLING TOTER OR CONTAINERS:
Any Black or Very Dark Plastic
Any Carton that has “wax” (milk, juice, soup, wine)
Any Compostable Plastic
Any Item with Food Residue
Anything 2” or Smaller (smaller than a credit card)
Clothing or Linens
Foods and Liquids
Frozen Food Boxes
Garden Hoses, String Lights, Ropes or other
“Tanglers”
Hot Coffee Cups (all types)
Napkins, Tissues, Towels or Wipes
Non-Food or Beverage Glass
Plastic Bags, Wraps, Films or Pouches
Shredded Paper
Tarps or Plastic Sheeting
Do you have a question about how to recycle an item?
Click link below:
https://recyclesmartma.org/beyond-the-bin-search/

TEXTILES AND BOOKS
Textiles and books: are accepted in recycling
dumpsters conveniently located on the premises.
These funds support the North Andover
Sustainability Committee. Other textile dumpsters
are located at all North Andover Public Schools in
support of your local PTO.
For more information on Municipal & School Box
Programs click the link below:
https://www.baystatetextiles.com/

WHAT TO EXPECT (CONTINUED)
TBI allows residents (non-businesses) to
dispose the Following Items FREE of Charge:
Appliances – washer, dryers, dishwashers,
stoves, hot water heaters
Fluorescent Light Bulbs – cannot be broken,
free of charge Ballasts – no PCB’s
Thermostats
Electronics (Laptop / PCU)
Scrap Metal
Household Batteries
Please contact TBI to confirm pricing and proper
prep of item being disposed - 978-686-2020: Credit
Cards accepted.
